values: 一名生存欲望强烈的游侠，会在敌人身上寄生“吮噬心核”并吸取宿主的生命和能量。
A cunning Rogue who values survival above all, she plants Drain Seeds to siphon life and Energy from her enemies.
Are these morsels enough to sustain me?
Ah, sustenance. Now I can grow.
I can't absorb this. Take it away.
The earth is used to survive and grow.
悉达并没有强烈的情感，唯一的欲望只有——生存。
Saida doesn't feel much. No rage or joy. Just one driving need... to survive.
如果要论耐心，全世界恐怕都没有能与悉达相提并论的生物——事实上，她也并没有烦躁这种情绪。
No creature in existence rivals Saida's patience. Though to be fair, she is a creature untouched by the very concept of impatience.
悉达不喜欢太冷、太暖、太晒、太暗、太干燥、太潮湿的天气，但这并不意味着她无法在这些气候下生存。
Saida hates all kinds of extreme weather. Not that any of it can actually kill her. This Hypogean thrives where others merely endure.
一个不为人知的秘密——悉达的视力和听力没有任何问题，但她几乎不依赖视觉和听觉的感官。
Here's a little-known secret. Saida's eyes and ears work just fine. But she barely relies on sight or sound.
通常来说，和悉达对话无法得到任何回应。
Generally speaking, talking to Saida never elicits a response.
悉达不需要水分，但给她浇普通的清水，确实会让她感到舒畅。
Saida doesn't need water to survive, but when you pour water over her, she still seems to enjoy it.
悉达在习性上也更接近植物——除非是寻求养分而不得不出击，否则她可以在同一个地方默默生活几百年而纹丝不动，直到养分耗尽。
Saida lives much like a plant. Unless she has to hunt for nutrients, she can stay rooted in one spot for centuries without moving a muscle. Only when her sustenance runs out would she finally stir.
需要提示的是，悉达只渴望生存，但并不会繁衍，她的每个种子内部都是她自己的一部分，也是她重生的根基。
Saida hungers not to multiply, but to endure. Each seed is no offspring. It is her own essence, coiled tight, waiting to reclaim the world.
在世界任何地方，任何年代，都存在着“猩红的藤蔓吞噬血肉”的传说，当然，那几乎都是悉达。
Saida cares only for her own survival. Not reproduction. Every seed she spawns carries a piece of herself, a chance at rebirth.
如果愿意的话，悉达能在极端的神圣光芒或者地心的岩浆里，以种子的形式休眠数百年，直到适宜复苏的时候到来。
If she wills it, Saida could hibernate for centuries. Whether bathed in Divine Light or buried deep in molten lava, she would wait as a seed until the moment was right to awaken.
这里，温度，适中，准备播种……
The temperature here... is mild... Seeding could be done...
